content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Biloxi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree and have documented hours of direct project-leadership experience. Review PMI's specific criteria on their website, then contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend interactive sessions from your location at your own pace, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, risk management, procurement, and exam domains. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world context and prepare you thoroughly for the PMI exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, submit your formal application directly to PMI, including your education, work experience, and Granite PM Academy's course completion certificate. Pay the PMI exam registration fee at that time. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you can schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll take the exam remotely or at an authorized testing center, answering 180 questions across five domains over three hours.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or self-directed learning. Renew your credential and fees with PMI before expiration to keep your PMP active and recognized across Biloxi's defense, maritime, hospitality, and healthcare sectors.
